beats.name: The intake maze
beats.note: There is no marked racing line. Read the gaps between stacked wrecks.

beats.name: Magnet courts
beats.note: Moving scrap warns of a live field. Keep your speed or take the wider alley.

beats.name: The breaker yards
beats.note: Crane loads fall. A buckling boom can take its whole load down.

beats.name: Air freight
beats.note: Cargo drones hover before dumping. Shadows show where the load will land.

beats.name: The last sorting court
beats.note: Find another gap if fresh scrap blocks the short line. Reach the far gantry.

collisionContract: src/scrapyard.js: elliptical salvage islands, shacks, tyre heaps, crawler bases, fallen-boom capsules, pushable loose bodies and vehicle magnetic lift. Grid reachability is validation, not a marked route.
